name: io.github.Servosity/granola-mcp
title: Granola MCP
description: Search and analyze every Granola meeting across all your calls, from an offline local mirror.

environmentVariables.name: GRANOLA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Granola public API key (Personal or Workspace) from Granola Settings > API. Powers sync, notes, transcripts, summaries, folders, and every local-store command.

environmentVariables.name: GRANOLA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Granola public API root. Leave unset to use https://public-api.granola.ai.
